name: Unreal assets
description: Unreal Engine assets and maps, .uasset and .umap, as the Content Browser shows them: the thumbnail the editor saved, the class, the engine that saved it, the file it was imported from, what the browser shows on hover — a texture's size and format, a mesh's triangles, an animation's frames — and the assets it uses. Thumbnails in the film strip too. Only the header is read, from UE 4.0 to 5.7; nothing is ever written.
author: xverb
